name: Basic Strike
description: A free baseline PHYSICAL MELEE ATTACK.

name: Basic Block
description: Raise a POTENCY 1 BLOCK that halves pure PHYSICAL ATTACKS for 12 AP TICKS.

name: Jab
description: A lightning-fast PHYSICAL MELEE jab.

name: Elbow Strike
description: A sharp, close-range PHYSICAL MELEE elbow strike.

name: Body Blow
description: Drive a fist into the gut: a MELEE blow with GUARD BREAK that blows straight through the target's BLOCK.

name: Sweeping Kick
description: A low PHYSICAL MELEE sweep that STUNs the target's active ACTION SEGMENT on a hit.

name: Knee Strike
description: A balanced PHYSICAL MELEE knee strike.

name: Overhand Punch
description: A committed HEAVY PHYSICAL MELEE overhand whose ACTION SEGMENT cannot be interrupted by STUN.

name: Reinforced Jab
description: A lightning-fast REINFORCEMENT MELEE jab.

name: Reinforced Elbow
description: A REINFORCEMENT MELEE elbow strike.

name: Reinforced Knee
description: A REINFORCEMENT MELEE knee strike, eligible for BLACK FLASH.

name: Cursed Energy Burst
description: Project a compact CURSED ENERGY RANGED burst.

name: Cursed Energy Blast
description: Unleash a HEAVY blast of raw CURSED ENERGY as a POTENCY 2 RANGED ATTACK whose ACTION SEGMENT resists STUN.

name: Deflection
description: Raise a POTENCY 1 BLOCK that fully negates MELEE ATTACKS for 5 AP TICKS.

name: Reinforced Deflection
description: Channel cursed energy to raise a POTENCY 1 BLOCK that fully negates MELEE ATTACKS for 5 AP TICKS.

name: Cross Guard
description: Raise a POTENCY 1 BLOCK that reduces pure PHYSICAL ATTACKS by 70% for 15 AP TICKS.

name: Reinforced Cross Guard
description: Channel cursed energy to raise a POTENCY 1 BLOCK that reduces any ATTACK by 70% for 15 AP TICKS.

name: Braced Guard
description: After a brief brace, raise a HEAVY, POTENCY 1 BLOCK that flat-reduces pure PHYSICAL ATTACKS by 20 for 20 AP TICKS.

name: Reinforced Braced Guard
description: After a brief brace, raise a HEAVY, POTENCY 1 BLOCK that flat-reduces any ATTACK by 30 for 20 AP TICKS.

name: Reinforced Basic Block
description: Channel cursed energy to raise a POTENCY 1 BLOCK that halves any ATTACK for 10 AP TICKS.

name: Cursed Energy Focus
description: Focus cursed energy to raise your ACCURACY by 20% for 2 ROUNDS.

name: Cursed Energy Surge
description: Surge cursed energy to raise your CURSED ENERGY OUTPUT by 20% for 1 ROUND.

name: Miracle Creation
description: With Miracle Reservoir active, create 1 MIRACLE (or 2 at CURSED TECHNIQUE MASTERY 225+), up to your capacity.

name: Sword Slash
description: A disciplined close-range PHYSICAL MELEE SWORD cut.

name: Sword Throw
description: Hurl your SWORD at the target as a PHYSICAL RANGED ATTACK.

name: Ratio Mark
description: With Ratio Reinforcement active, place 1 RATIO STACK (or 2 at CURSED TECHNIQUE MASTERY 200+) on the target, up to your capacity.

name: Ratio Strike
description: On a MELEE hit, drive RATIO into the target, bypassing BLOCK and resolving the strike against 30% DEFENSE.

name: Batto Sword Drawing
description: A swift iaijutsu draw: a REINFORCEMENT SWORD MELEE strike that STUNs.

name: Simple Domain
description: Establish a Simple Domain that intercepts the next MELEE or RANGED ATTACK, absorbing RANGED PHYSICAL strikes behind a full BLOCK and countering MELEE assailants with Batto Sword Drawing.

name: Sidestep
description: Gain a 40% chance to DODGE MELEE ATTACKS for 8 AP TICKS.

name: Weapon Parry
description: PARRY POTENCY 1 ATTACKS for 3 AP TICKS, STAGGERing non-GUARD BREAK attackers for 4 AP TICKS.

name: Evasive Dash
description: Gain a 75% chance to DODGE RANGED ATTACKS for 10 AP TICKS.

name: Divergent Fist
description: A PHYSICAL MELEE lead strike followed by a delayed CURSED ENERGY impact from the lagging fist.

name: Summon White Dog
description: Draw Divine Dog White from your shadow; it materializes and joins the fight next ROUND.

name: Summon Black Dog
description: Draw Divine Dog Black from your shadow; it materializes and joins the fight next ROUND.

name: Katana Combination
description: Chain disciplined SWORD cuts into a swift PHYSICAL MELEE flurry.

name: Cursed Sword Slash
description: Drive a cursed tool forward in a crushing REINFORCEMENT MELEE SWORD strike.

name: Cursed Tool Deflection
description: PARRY POTENCY 1 PHYSICAL and CURSED ENERGY ATTACKS for 3 AP TICKS, STAGGERing the attacker for 1 AP TICK.

name: Keen Observation
description: Read the opponent's rhythm to raise your ACCURACY and EVASION by 15% for 1 ROUND.

name: Summon Nue
description: Draw Nue from your shadow; it materializes and joins the fight next ROUND.

name: Summon Toad
description: Draw Toad Gamma from your shadow; it materializes and joins the fight next ROUND.

name: Summon Great Serpent
description: Draw Great Serpent Orochi from your shadow; it materializes and joins the fight next ROUND.

name: Summon Divine Dog Totality
description: Draw Divine Dog Totality from your shadow; it materializes and joins the fight next ROUND.

name: Summon Toad/Nue Fusion
description: Fuse Toad and Nue through Well's Unknown Abyss into a winged swarm that joins the fight next ROUND.

name: Summon Max Elephant
description: Draw Max Elephant from your shadow; it materializes and joins the fight next ROUND.

name: Dog Ambush
description: Command an active Divine Dog to strike from the target's shadow in a two-hit RANGED assault.

name: Nue Lightning Strike
description: Command an active Nue to call lightning down on a distant target and STUN it.

name: Toad Pull
description: Have Toad yank you clear, granting a 75% DODGE chance against MELEE and RANGED ATTACKS for 6 AP TICKS.

name: Serpent Snare
description: Command an active Great Serpent to lunge from the target's shadow and STUN it from range.

name: Totality Rush
description: Drive Divine Dog Totality through the target in an overwhelming close-range MELEE rush.

name: Winged Toad Snare
description: Send three winged toads at the target, each lashing out with a binding tongue that can STUN.

name: Elephant Drop
description: Drop Max Elephant onto every enemy in a HEAVY POTENCY 2 impact with GUARD BREAK.

name: Shadow Movement
description: Flow through shadow for an 85% DODGE chance against MELEE and RANGED ATTACKS for 7 AP TICKS.

name: Desummon
description: Return this shikigami to the summoner's shadow, ready to be called again next ROUND.

name: Divine Dog Bite
description: Sink cursed-energy-reinforced fangs into the target with a REINFORCEMENT MELEE bite.

name: Tracking Pounce
description: Track the target's cursed trace and pounce with a REINFORCEMENT MELEE strike that never misses.

name: Rending Pounce
description: Pounce with enough force to shred a guarding target: a REINFORCEMENT MELEE strike with GUARD BREAK.

name: Electrified Talons
description: Rake the target with electrified talons in a REINFORCEMENT MELEE strike.

name: Lightning Discharge
description: Loose a concentrated bolt of CURSED ENERGY from range that STUNs the target.

name: Tongue Lash
description: Lash the target from range with a reinforced tongue: a REINFORCEMENT RANGED strike.

name: Binding Tongue
description: Bind the target in Toad's tongue, STAGGERing it for 4 AP TICKS with a REINFORCEMENT RANGED strike.

name: Serpent Constrict
description: Coil around the target and STAGGER it for 8 AP TICKS with a REINFORCEMENT MELEE constriction.

name: Devouring Lunge
description: Commit to a HEAVY POTENCY 2 lunge with GUARD BREAK that devours through the target's guard.

name: Totality Claw
description: Tear through the target with Divine Dog Totality's empowered claws in a REINFORCEMENT MELEE strike.

name: Predator Rush
description: Rush the target with two consecutive REINFORCEMENT MELEE claw strikes.

name: Crushing Stomp
description: Stomp every enemy beneath immense weight in a HEAVY POTENCY 2 impact with GUARD BREAK.

name: Water Deluge
description: Inundate every enemy with a CURSED ENERGY RANGED torrent.

name: Winged Tongue Snare
description: Three winged toads lash the target with binding tongues, each strike able to STUN.

name: Aerial Swarm
description: Swarm every enemy from the air, lowering their ACCURACY by 20% for 1 ROUND.

name: Don't Move
description: Command up to three enemies to halt. Success STAGGERs them for 6 AP TICKS, and each target also inflicts RECOIL (even if resisted) that scales with its cursed energy.

name: Blast Away
description: Command up to three enemies to be blasted back. Success deals damage and STAGGERs them for 4 AP TICKS, and each target also inflicts RECOIL (even if resisted) that scales with its cursed energy.

name: Sleep
description: Command up to three enemies to SLEEP. They slumber until damaged, a 5% per-tick wake chance, or the ROUND's end, and each target also inflicts RECOIL (even if resisted) that scales with its cursed energy.

name: Plummet
description: Command up to three enemies to plummet. Success deals damage and STUNs their active ACTION SEGMENT, and each target also inflicts RECOIL (even if resisted) that scales with its cursed energy.

name: Get Twisted
description: Command up to three enemies to twist apart. Success deals heavy damage, and each target also inflicts RECOIL (even if resisted) that scales with its cursed energy.

name: Return
description: Command up to three enemy summons to return to their summoner on success.

name: Explode
description: Command up to three enemies to explode. Success deals massive damage, and each target also inflicts RECOIL (even if resisted) that scales with its cursed energy.

name: Die
description: Command up to three enemies to die. Success slays them outright (halting at 1 HP against fatal protection), and each target also inflicts heavy RECOIL (even if resisted) that scales with its cursed energy.

name: Reinforced Strike
description: A basic REINFORCEMENT MELEE strike.

name: Grapple
description: Seize the target with a low-ACCURACY PHYSICAL MELEE ATTACK that has a 50% chance to STUN its active ACTION SEGMENT.

name: Triple Kick
description: Unleash three explosive PHYSICAL MELEE kicks, each with 85% BASE ACCURACY.

name: Upper Cut
description: Drive a medium-power PHYSICAL MELEE uppercut into the target with a 5% chance to STUN its active ACTION SEGMENT.

name: Reinforced Triple Kick
description: Reinforce three explosive MELEE kicks with CURSED ENERGY for 75 combined BASE POWER, each with 85% BASE ACCURACY.

name: Reinforced Upper Cut
description: Drive a CURSED ENERGY-reinforced MELEE uppercut into the target for 45 BASE POWER with a 5% chance to STUN its active ACTION SEGMENT.

name: Taunt
description: Provoke your foes, forcing their single-target MELEE attacks onto you for 20 ticks. Area-of-effect attacks are unaffected.

name: Out of the way
description: Shout a warning and pull a single ALLY out of harm's way, granting them a 50% chance to DODGE RANGED ATTACKS for 8 AP TICKS.
